name: Oumi Renri
source: The protagonist, and also Kokoro's older brother. He's the caretaker of the Erdõs dormitary, and a 2nd year high school student. He's also a skillful cook, and always worried for the dorm's tenants. And because of that, all the dorm's tenants called him "Mom", which Renri is kind of annoyed with it.
